repos_data.description: Create your Java crypto trading bot in minutes. Our Spring boot starter takes care of exchange connections, accounts, orders, trades, and positions so you can focus on building your strategies.

Idiomatic Go SDK for KuCoin REST & WebSocket APIs — UTA (Unified Trading Account) and Classic (Spot, Margin, Futures). Hand-written, not generated. String-typed prices, HMAC-SHA256 auth, context-aware methods, typed error hierarchy, conservative retry policy, injectable HTTP client, and manifest-driven endpoint documentation.
